name: lviv-secondhand-native
description: Capacitor Android wrapper for the Lviv Second Hand PWA. Loads the live site (https://www.lvivsecondhand.com) in a native shell so the store dataset is never shipped inside the APK.

scripts.build:debug: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
